headline: oftheblue drop first concept photos for debut
sub: JYP's new boy group debuts Jan 11 with 'out of the blue'
source: Source: JYP Entertainment via Korean media
caption:
JYP's new boy group oftheblue has unveiled the first concept photos for their debut mini album 'out of the blue'.

The group comes from SQU4D, the JYP label team behind NMIXX, and is SQU4D's first boy group. Their official debut is set for January 11, 2027 at 6 PM KST, and more teasers are expected in the run-up.

📌 Source: JYP Entertainment, via Korean media (Ilgan Sports, Herald Muse, Sports Kyunghyang)
